title: Network Pharmacology-Integrated Molecular Docking Reveals the Expected Anticancer Mechanism of Picrorhizae Rhizoma Extract.
authors: Hu, Xiaomeng; Zhao, Shengchao; Cai, Yi; Swain, Shasank S; Yao, Liangliang; Liu, Wei; Yan, Tingdong
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究胡黄连提取物的抗癌机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: This study sought to explore the anticancer mechanism of Picrorhizae Rhizoma (PR) extract based on network pharmacology and molecular docking. The potential chemicals of PR were screened through the Traditional Chinese Medicine Systems Pharmacology (TCMSP) database and relevant literatures. Corresponding targets of active ingredients were found with the help of the UniProtKB database, and therapeutic targets for cancer action were screened with the help of the GeneCards database. We used Cytoscape software to construct the compound-target-pathway network of PR extract. We utilized the STRING database to obtain the protein-protein interaction (PPI) network. We used DAVID database combining Gene Ontology (GO) analysis and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) pathway enrichment analysis. Finally, molecular docking was employed for initial efficacy checking. We have identified 16 potential active components of PR through screening, involving 112 disease action targets. Utilizing the GeneCards database, 112 intersecting targets between PR extract and cancer were found, which mainly exerts anticancer effects by regulating tumor necrosis factor (TNF), recombinant caspase 3 (CASP3), c-Jun NH2-terminal kinase (JNK)/JUN, epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR), and estrogen receptor-1 (ESR1) with some other target genes and pathways associated with cancer. The major anticancer species are prostate cancer, colorectal cancer, small cell lung cancer, etc. In the molecular docking study, herbactin had a strong affinity for TNF. Based on network pharmacology and molecular docking studies, PR and their compounds have demonstrated potential anticancer activities against several key targets. Our preliminary findings provide a strong foundation for further experiments with PR constituents.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在基于网络药理学和分子对接技术，探讨胡黄连（Picrorhizae Rhizoma, PR）提取物的抗癌机制。通过中药系统药理学数据库（TCMSP）及相关文献筛选PR的潜在化学成分。借助UniProtKB数据库查找活性成分的对应靶点，并利用GeneCards数据库筛选癌症作用的治疗靶点。我们使用Cytoscape软件构建PR提取物的化合物-靶点-通路网络。利用STRING数据库获取蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络。使用DAVID数据库结合基因本体（GO）分析和京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）通路富集分析。最后，采用分子对接进行初步效能验证。通过筛选，我们识别出PR的16种潜在活性成分，涉及112个疾病作用靶点。利用GeneCards数据库，发现PR提取物与癌症之间有112个交集靶点，主要通过调控肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）、重组半胱天冬酶3（CASP3）、c-Jun NH2末端激酶（JNK）/JUN、表皮生长因子受体（EGFR）和雌激素受体1（ESR1）等一些与癌症相关的靶基因和通路发挥抗癌作用。主要抗癌类型包括前列腺癌、结直肠癌、小细胞肺癌等。在分子对接研究中，胡黄连素与TNF具有较强亲和力。基于网络药理学和分子对接研究，PR及其化合物已显示出对多个关键靶点的潜在抗癌活性。我们的初步发现为PR成分的进一步实验提供了坚实基础。
